summary: Restricted-candidate-list construction samples TSP steps from a band of low-cost outgoing edges.
description: Input is a complete finite matrix, a random generator, an alpha in [0, 1] and a start. Output is an open tour.

At each step recompute minimum and maximum outgoing costs among unused vertices. Sample uniformly within the threshold from the minimum to minimum plus alpha times the range. A zero alpha uses a cheapest tie and alpha one admits all options. Construction costs quadratic time apart from sorting eligible ties.
